fusions.name: Nip and Slip
fusions.desc: Snaps at the target, dealing 4 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and giving you 15% more movement speed for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dust Cloud
fusions.desc: Kicks up a cone of silt 3 tiles ahead that deals 10 damage, knocks enemies 2 tiles back and gives each a 50% chance of [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Surface
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Dark Water
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%. Your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
